jobs.occupation: Pilot Line PDK & Design Enablement Lead (all genders) // Job-ID: 246-0
jobs.description:
Silicon Austria Labs (SAL) - In the network of science and industry, SAL offers research in the areas of Sensor Systems, RF Systems, Power Electronics, System Integration Technologies and Embedded Systems.

SAL - a great place to research. 1 Pilot Line PDK & Design Enablement Lead (all genders) // Job-ID: 246-0 

Deine zukünftigen Aufgaben

In the Position as Staff Research Engineer you are responsible for the central PDK function across SAL's technology platforms and pilot-line activities. You ensure that PDK content, models, verification flows, documentation, and release processes are consistent, traceable, and aligned with fabrication capabilities-enabling reliable design-to-fab handshakes for internal teams and open-access users (with a strong relevance for integrated photonics and related quantum/MEMS device concepts).

Your responsibilities include:

 * PDK strategy & roadmap: define and maintain a consolidated PDK roadmap (priorities, maturity targets, releases) aligned with platform and fabrication evolution.

 * PDK governance & release management: establish a structured release process (versioning, release notes, change control, qualification evidence, deprecation rules) and ensure predictable delivery for users.

 * Design-to-fab interface: act as the interface between designers and fabrication teams to align layer definitions, design rules, tolerances, process assumptions, sign-off criteria, and handover packages.

 * PDK content quality: own quality of PDK deliverables such as DRC/LVS/PEX flows (as applicable), models, corners/variability knobs, examples, and user documentation.

 * Validation & calibration: coordinate validation and calibration plans with measurement/metrology and process teams; ensure model updates are evidence-based and traceable to wafer data.

 * EDA and enablement flows: maintain compatibility with relevant EDA toolchains; provide reference flows, templates, and automation where beneficial (build/release tooling, regression checks).

 * User support & enablement: support internal teams and selected external open-access users (onboarding, requirements clarification, feedback capture) and translate user needs into backlog items.

 * Documentation & know-how management: ensure strong documentation discipline and coordinate what can be shared externally vs what must be protected, in collaboration with responsible functions.

Dein Profil

 * Strong experience (min. 8+ years) in PDK development and design enablement (verification flows, models, documentation, releases) in a semiconductor / photonics / MEMS-related environment.

 * MSc/PhD in EE, Physics, Photonics, Microsystems, or comparable.

 * Solid understanding of the design-fabrication interface and how process variability impacts models, rules, and design margins.

 * Hands-on experience with EDA ecosystems and PDK integration; scripting/automation skills (e.g., Python/TCL) are a strong plus.

 * Experience working with wafer data for model calibration/validation and structured change control.

 * Strong communication skills and ability to coordinate across a matrix organization (design, process teams, metrology, external users).

 * Fluent English; German is a plus.

This position is subject to the Collective Agreement for employees in non-university research (Research CA) starting in occupational group F (F1 salary = EUR 4.757,- paid 14 times a year, based on 38,5 hours per week). For this position we offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your experience and qualifications, starting with a minimum gross salary of EUR 70.000 (annual, based on an All-in contract and bonus).

jobs.description:
To Recruitment Agencies:

Allianz SE has an in-house recruitment team that sources great candidates directly. Therefore, Allianz SE does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies or search firm recruiters.

When we do work with recruitment agencies, that engagement is formalized by a contract. Fees will only be paid when there is a contract in place. Without a contract in place, we will not accept invoices on unsolicited resumes, even if the candidate was ultimately employed by Allianz.

Please do not contact hiring managers directly.

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us.

At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. And the foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and nurtures a culture grounded in integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust.

We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

Who will you join?

GCL (Group Center of Competence Life) drives the Life business within the Allianz Group through a combination of strategy development and hands-on business initiatives. LIT (Life Internationalization team) is one out of five units in GCL, focusing on

- a group-wide program to further develop our unit-linked business in terms of volume (assets under management) and the share of wallet of the assets managers belonging to the Group
- productivity levers in Life (in collaboration with H4/Az Tech), e.g. by digital customer journeys and a Life IT strategy which reflects the needs of the respective business models
- influence distribution and incentive patterns to help achieve our strategic ambitions in Life
sustainability-related topics which are specific to Life business

How can you make an impact?

- Drive the successful (co-)development, improvement and implementation of new concepts and solutions together with the relevant stakeholders all over the Group
- Participate in research and fact finding as a solid fundament for the elements of our strategy, challenging the status quo and working closely with other GCL teams and a variety of stakeholders in planning, structuring and steering projects and initiatives
- Prepare presentations, status reports and business reviews
Prepare and facilitate business network and community meetings, including documentation and follow-up

What are you made of?

- University degree in mathematics, business studies/economics, finance or related subjects
- Professional experience in an operational Life or related entity, thereof at least two years in an Allianz OE
- Solid knowledge and experience in preferably two of the following areas: Life Products/Actuarial, investment or asset management, Sales & Distribution, Finance, IT/Operations
- Passion for numbers, in combination with smart communication of complex topics to a broader audience
- Fluent in English and at least one other business language of relevance in the Group
- Project management capabilities and ability to independently manage communities
- Entrepreneurial, resilient mindset, collaborative and enthusiastic
- Previous experience in insurance or asset management business functions, consulting, digital / tech is a plus
- Experience applying ChatGPT, Generative AI, and Ethical AI solution

Do we have what you need?

- Flexible and hybrid work model
- Multinational and inclusive community
- Great career development and learning opportunities
- Company pension and health insurance
- Employee stock purchase program with a discount
- Health and well-being offerings
- Supportive family care benefits
- Opportunity to contribute to our sustainability programs
- Great place to work certified

And there is much more: Allianz SE Benefits

jobs.description:
WELCOME TO BASF

In Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. As a specialized service unit we ensure a high level of customer orientation and we design our services to be cooperative, efficient and future-oriented.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT
Within our Middle Office Treasury EMEA team, you gain broad insights into corporate treasury operations and contribute to a variety of activities across Banking, Financing & Planning or Hedging in an international environment. Depending on your background and development path, your responsibilities may include following tasks:

In this role, you help ensure smooth banking operations by supporting bank account management, banking mandates, KYC processes, and compliance-related activities.
Together with your team and a variety of internal stakeholders, you foster strong and collaborative relationships with banking partners and support transparent communication.
In close cooperation with relevant business functions, you contribute to liquidity planning, cash management, cash pooling, and cash disposition activities.
You further support foreign exchange risk management through exposure calculations, hedging activities, and the maintenance of FX rates.
In addition, you contribute to treasury reporting, regulatory submissions, and the continuous improvement and digitalization of treasury processes.

- Last but not least, you work closely with BASF entities, digitalization initiatives, and operational excellence across treasury processes.
- vocational training or completed degree with focus on Treasury, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Commercial Business or related fields
- work experience in Accounting, Finance, Controlling or the banking sector is a plus
- knowledge of MS Office and first experiences with SAP or other ERP systems
- analytical skills and technical affinity, first experience in VBA is beneficial
- fluent in English, further languages skills (German, Turkish, Russian, Italian, etc.) are an advantage

WHAT WE OFFER

- Gross annual salary (full-time): 35.000 - 39.000 €, depending on qualification and work experience - in addition, you can expect a bonus dependent on the company's success
- 30 days of paid vacation, special leave and sabbatical options
- Flexible working hours so that you can organize your working and private life according to your needs
- Modern sustainable office building in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg with flexible working options, rooftop terrace and cafeteria for innovative and team-focused collaboration - get to know our location
- Team and company events in which we celebrate our achievements and live up our team spirit
- Location-independent work models with defined days of presence in Berlin and place of residence in Germany - Here a first impression
- Subsidy for public transport, personal employee benefit card and other discounts
- Work mobile from other EU countries for up to six weeks

HOW TO REACH US

- Katarina Borisov (Talent Acquisition), Tel.:+49 30 2005-59269 will be happy to answer your questions for this position.
- You can also reach our recruiting team here.
- First information about our application process can be found here and in our Q&A video.

What to Expect

In this role, you will work closely with the Central European leadership team to rapidly scale and expand the network of Tesla locations across 8 markets in Central Europe. As a Market Expansion Associate, you will be responsible for the development of the expansion strategy and its execution.You will work directly with Sales, Service, and Delivery leaders as well as the Real Estate and Infrastructure Development team to create and implement market growth strategies. As part of this team, you will develop in-depth knowledge of market dynamics across Central Europe to define cohesive business plans and align on the top company priorities to achieve both short-term and long-term objectives. You will have the unique opportunity to further develop your skills in data-driven strategic planning and day-to-day operations, and to apply your skills in qualitative and quantitative analysis, project management, problem-solving, and stakeholder management.

What You’ll Do

- You own the market expansion planning and analytics process, including forecast analysis, market expansion strategy, and operational setup
- You conduct in-depth market research and combine qualitative and quantitative analysis to define and execute the expansion strategy
- You use internal and external data tools to build the plans and business cases for opportunities, and to forecast expected demand, utilization, and headcount for new infrastructure projects
- You communicate effectively with the senior management team to establish, present, and discuss business cases for expansion projects and align business priorities
- You coordinate search campaigns and conduct site visits to ensure we identify the ideal infrastructure in key markets and cities
- You collaborate with cross-functional teams and local Sales and Service teams to structure and accelerate the opening of new locations
- You coordinate with business planning counterparts on wider expansion plans and performance monitoring across EMEA

What You’ll Bring

- You have strong analytical skills and the ability to manage and interpret large data sets
- You can create executive-level presentations quickly based on derived insights
- You want to work in a fast-paced environment while also paying attention to detail
- You have a hard-working mindset and are willing to go above and beyond to reach your goals
- You are passionate about strategy, business development, project management, operations, and process improvement
- You are willing to travel across Central Europe for project work
- You have excellent communication skills and are fluent in English; German is a plus

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

Focus: Storytelling at the Table, Nutritional Science & Green Michelin Star Hospitality

Location: Allgäu, Germany (Bavaria)

Contract: Full-Time / Trainee with Academic Certification

Tired of just carrying plates and reciting memorized daily specials?

In traditional restaurants, the front-of-house staff merely delivers food. At our resort, the service team is the voice of functional medicine and sustainable gastronomy.

Our guests visit not only for fine dining, but to optimize cellular health, sleep, metabolic resilience, and systemic calm. Your role is to bridge the kitchen and the guest: You explain why bitter herbs open the liver pathways, how spermidin triggers autophagy, and why our fermented pairings stabilize glucose levels.

Your Playground & Impact:

· Master active storytelling across our 10 clinical guest archetypes (from metabolic stress recovery to neuro-regeneration).

· Guide international guests through 100% non-alcoholic botanical pairings, explaining the biochemical function of cold-brewed extracts and live ferments at table-side.

· Join our accredited Longevity Hospitality Traineeship: Complete structured academic training with an official German university certification in Functional Nutrition & Phytotherapy alongside your floor shifts.

· Act as an essential ambassador during Michelin inspector visits, presenting verifiably sustainable and organic supply chains.

Who You Are:

· Background in upscale hotel service, fine dining (Chef de Rang, Senior Waiter), or modern gastronomy.

· Highly empathetic communicator with a passion for health, functional nutrition, and authentic guest interaction.

· Fluent in English (German is a strong plus); open to international applicants with valid residence, Schengen status, or Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte).

· Enthusiastic about learning nutritional biochemistry to elevate table-side storytelling to an art form.

What We Offer (Candidate Value Proposition):

· Academic University Certification: Official trainee certificate / module in Longevity Nutrition & Functional Food from an accredited German university partner.

· Visa & Relocation Support: Full guidance through official immigration procedures, Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte), or German work permits, plus initial on-site resort accommodation.

· Green Michelin Star Mission: Active, pioneering role in building Germany’s benchmark for Sustainable & Functional Fine Dining from day one.

· Cutting-Edge Food Lab: Access to professional vacuum blending, cold-press extraction technology, fermentation chambers, and an extensive in-house botanical garden.
